nodes.title: Input Parameters
widgets_values:
## Input Parameters

Encodes the prompts and prepares the source:

- resizes it so the short side is 1088 and both sides are multiples of 32;
- pads it with copies of the last frame so it splits into whole **81-frame chunks** (161 frames for a 145-frame clip).

nodes.title: Loop Start
widgets_values:
## Chunk loop

Everything between **Loop Start** and **Loop End** runs once per chunk. Chunks start every 80 frames and overlap by one frame.

widgets_values_named.text:

nodes.title: Preprocess (per chunk)
widgets_values:
## Preprocess

Cuts this chunk from the padded clip and uses it as the IC-LoRA reference. From the second chunk on, frame 0 is pinned to the previous chunk's last matte frame so the chunks join seamlessly.

nodes.title: Sampler (per chunk)
widgets_values:
## Sampler

15 steps, CFG 1. The same seed is used for every chunk.

widgets_values_named.text:
## Sampler

nodes.title: Decode (per chunk)
widgets_values:
## Decode

Decodes the chunk and keeps its new frames (later chunks drop frame 0, the pin). The last frame becomes the next chunk's pin.

Lower the tile sizes if you run out of memory.

widgets_values_named.text:

nodes.title: Stitch
widgets_values:
## Stitch

Joins the chunks, drops the padded frames and resizes the matte back to the source size, so it lines up with the original. The video is written at the source frame rate, like the API (the model itself is always conditioned at 24 fps).
